description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. This collection records public AT&T cellular measurements from a tethered helikite above NC State North Campus. DataCite identifies the 2023 Packapalooza campaign and CSV and KML files containing cellular indicators with latitude, longitude and altitude. The AERPAW landing describes one-second logs and a flight reaching about 120 metres. Its copied private-network introduction conflicts with the public-network title; the registered DOI abstract confirms public AT&T scope. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Public cellular coverage for aerial users. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
